problem_context.core_problem: Distributed finance companies face exponentially complex regulatory requirements across 50+ jurisdictions with manual compliance monitoring consuming 15-20% of operations budget

market_context.market_dynamics: Fintech regulatory enforcement doubled in past 18 months; companies moving to Series B+ adding CCO roles
market_context.regulatory_environment: CFPB enforcement increasing, state-by-state requirements multiplying, no unified framework

customer_context.primary_segment: Growth-stage fintechs ($50M-$500M ARR) with multi-jurisdiction operations
customer_context.jtbd_functional: Automate compliance monitoring and reduce regulatory risk without hiring large compliance teams
customer_context.jtbd_emotional: Feel confident in regulatory posture and protected from enforcement action

key_assumptions: Fintech companies will prioritize automation over hiring compliance staff
Regulatory complexity will continue increasing YoY
Enterprise SaaS model is appropriate for compliance automation
